description: This header file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project. It includes functions for retrieving security tokens, checking Thunder security configuration, and managing plugin states.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving and managing security tokens, including checking Thunder security configuration.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function, with conditional inheritance based on compilation flags.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, either from cache or by calling external utilities, with thread safety.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for writing curl response data into a string.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is configured by querying a local service.
